title: 日本ダービーの後に・あなたの夢の次は

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I did it… I won! I'm the Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mom! Mama! I actually did it!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: That was so inspiring! Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe… Congrats. You were incredible, really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But this isn't the end… I'm gonna beat you next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky lost to Special Week, and the crowd's reaction is as expected.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Special Week sure is something! At this rate, she's definitely gonna win the next one too!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: That's right, she's the real deal! She'll always be the favorite to win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but… I agree with what they're saying. She's still improving.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess that just means I have to get better before the Kikuka Sho too… Psh, yeah right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the last race of the Classic Triple Crown on the horizon, the Umamusume welcome in the coming summer.
